what.text: This page follows people displaced inside Jamaica; the sources here record only displacement by disasters.
At the end of 2025, IDMC counted 279000 people still displaced by disasters.

why.text: Storms are the disasters recorded for Jamaica in IDMC's data.
The sources here have no armed conflict or dated events for Jamaica.

when.text: IDMC recorded far more new displacements from disasters in 2025 than in any earlier year in its data.
Its figure for people still displaced at year end covers only 2025.

how.text: IDMC's new displacements count movements, not people: someone forced to move twice in a year is counted twice.
Refugees from Jamaica are few and live mainly in the United States and Canada.
The sources don't say where inside Jamaica people moved to.
